cohort: Studies examining pediatric populations (human and animal) on the microbiota-gut-brain axis and neuropsychiatric development were included.
finding: Alterations in the pediatric gut microbiota are linked to neurodevelopmental and psychiatric conditions such as ASD, ADHD, and mood disorders, suggesting early-life modulation of the gut microbiota may reduce the risk or severity of these disorders.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery is identified as a key determinant of microbiota development in childhood, which in turn influences the risk or severity of neuropsychiatric outcomes.
